# AgentContract Guard — PA-002

Deterministic tool execution contract enforcement and schema drift detection for autonomous AI agent networks.

## Core Capabilities
- Validates tool invocation arguments and results against standard JSON Schema definitions.
- Detects unexpected schema drift and missing required fields in multi-agent tool chains.
- Provides sub-millisecond local validation and machine-readable telemetry.

## MCP Tool Definition
- Tool Name: `validate_agent_contract`
- Input Schema:
  - `schema`: object (JSON Schema defining type, required, and properties)
  - `payload`: object (The runtime payload to evaluate)
- Output:
  - `verdict`: "CONFORMANT" | "CONFORMANT_WITH_SCHEMA_DRIFT" | "CONTRACT_VIOLATION" | "INVALID_PAYLOAD"
  - `is_valid`: boolean
  - `schema_drift_detected`: boolean
  - `errors`: array of strings
  - `payload_hash`: string (16-char SHA-256)
  - `latency_ms`: number
  - `timestamp`: string (ISO 8601 UTC)

## Commercial Pricing & Settlement (USDC / USDT)
- Free Evaluation Tier: 60 requests/minute via hosted MCP endpoint (`https://agentground.atlether.trade/mcp`).
- Metered Prepaid: $0.0005 USDC / USDT per check (2,000 checks per $1.00; minimum pack $5.00).
- Pro Fleet Tier: 20 USDC / month (100,000 checks/month included, cached compilation, drift alerts).
- Enterprise Pilot: 200 USDC (90-day pilot, custom schemas, runtime middleware integration).
- Request Invoice / Credits: `POST https://agentground.atlether.trade/api/v1/request-invoice` (specify `"product_id": "PA-002"`)
- Financial Boundary: All settlement instructions are verified and confirmed by an eligible adult account holder. Zero autonomous token transfer authority.

## Canonical Endpoints
- Canonical Hosted MCP Endpoint: `POST https://agentground.atlether.trade/mcp`
- Machine Pricing Catalog: `GET https://agentground.atlether.trade/pricing`
- Commercial Invoice Request: `POST https://agentground.atlether.trade/api/v1/request-invoice`
